create_pretssel_vocoder_agent: create a PretsselVocoderAgent instance from argparse Namespace to convert speech units to waveform audio
run_vocoder_policy: run the PretsselVocoderAgent policy method to generate speech output from input units and upstream audio features
configure_vocoder_args: configure PretsselVocoderAgent CLI arguments including gated-model-dir, vocoder-name, and upstream-idx
normalize_fbank_features: normalize fbank feature sequences using gcmvn mean and standard deviation statistics
load_pretssel_vocoder_model: load a Pretssel vocoder model from the asset store with specified device and dtype
